title: [Stable-ABI] Move acc_type into torch::headeronly.
body:
Moves the accumulate-type traits into `torch::headeronly`. Needed for torchvision stable-ABI, which currently carries a local [AccType helper](https://github.com/pytorch/vision/blob/9769007f09193b307a90d2b833aac31d364f03e3/torchvision/csrc/ops/cuda/nms_kernel.cu#L27-L38)  that only covers the types it dispatches.

## Summary
- Introduces `acc_type`, `acc_type_device`, `AccumulateType` and `AccumulateTypeDevice` in the `torch::headeronly` namespace.

cc @janeyx99
